title: AgentDefinition
description: Schema for MCP Security Control Plane agent definitions

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent, used in routing and audit logs

name.description: Human-readable display name for the agent

tier.description: Security tier controlling capability grants. T0 = highest trust (automated, no human-in-loop), T1 = standard (human approval required for sensitive ops)

description.description: Detailed description of the agent's purpose, capabilities and constraints

tool_grants.description: List of tool identifiers this agent is authorized to call. Must respect tier constraints.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per LLM call. Enforced by BudgetEnforcer.

model_id.description: Bedrock model ID for this agent. Must be an approved model from the allowlist.

system_prompt.description: System prompt injected at the start of every conversation for this agent

temperature.description: LLM sampling temperature. Defaults to 0 for deterministic security analysis.

requires_approval.description: If true, sensitive tool calls require human-in-the-loop approval via ApprovalGate

max_iterations.description: Maximum LangGraph iteration cycles before forced termination

tags.description: Metadata tags for grouping, filtering, and observability
